scope: uniform over continuous time, all four routes, including negative staging and stationary steering; endpoint-only sampling is not the proof
proof: For matched trapezoidal profiles: integral |v_q-v| <= sum length errors; |yaw_q-yaw| <= sum(|k_q-k|*ell_q + |ell_q-ell|/6); L1 position <= 3/2*(length_error + 80*yaw_error); body <= position_L1 + rB*yaw_error. All real/rational counts agree.
